## What's Changed

- AI investigations now plan from Data View metadata and form hypotheses from bounded document samples and aggregations.
- Explore can start an investigation directly from a document using its Data View and applied time range.
- Back and Forward navigate between in-app pages.
- Added the investigation pipeline diagram; knowledge-base storage and retrieval remain future work.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.1.4-alpha...0.2.0-alpha
